text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, April 15 - Chittagong - 24 Vessels in port of which 4 containers, 9 general cargo, 3 tankers, 4 foodgrain, 2 others, 1 cement clinker, 1 cement. 28 Vessels due by 25/4 of which 17 container vessels, 3 general cargo, 1 fertiliser, 3 car carriers, 1 scrap, tankers. No berthing delays, port operating normally.

INDIA, April 14 - Bombay - Delays expected, container vessels 1-2 days, bulk 3-4 days, general cargo 1-2 days. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 11 discharging, 1 discharging at anchorage, 8 waiting at anchorage to load, 11 to discharge, 5 under repair, 1 awaiting orders. Calcutta - 31 Vessels due (2 coking coal, 14 product tankers, 6 containers, 1 general, 1 crude, 2 coal, 2 logs, 1 timber, 2 peas). 7 Vessels loading at berth, 14 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 2 bunkering.

Cochin - Eight vessels due. Up to 1 days delay expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 tug and 1 small vessel at dock, 1 general cargo at jetty. Chennai (Madras) - 42 Vessels due (14 general cargo, 9 coal, 12 containers, 2 fertiliser, 1 edible oil, 1 meg, 2 iron ore, 1 molasses). Delays, coal/coke, fertiliser, others 2-3 days, scrap 4-5 days. No delays containers and iron ore. 1 Loading at berth, 13 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 7 to discharge.

Mormugao - 14 Vessels due, 4-5 days delay expected, 3 loading at anchorage, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 3 under repair/drydock. Kandla - 11 Vessels due, 5-6 days delay. 6 Loading at berth, 6 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 3 tankers, 14 waiting. Mangalore - Nine vessels due, 1-2 days delay expected. 7 Loading/discharging at berth, 3 waiting, 1 other. Jawaharlal Nehru - One foodgrain vessel due, 10-12 days delay, 2 tankers due, 10-12 days delay, 3 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge.

Paradip - Nine vessels due, (4 coal, 1 iron ore, 2 fertiliser, 2 chemical/gas), 5-6 days delay. 4 Loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 to discharge. Tuticorin - Four due, 2-3 days delay, 5 loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 6 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 to discharge, 1 under repairs/dry-dock. Visakhapatnam - Nine due, 7-8 days delay, 7 loading at berth, 8 discharging, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge inner harbour berth, 4 to load at inner harbour berth.

MALAYSIA, April 16 - Port Keelang - North/south port - Container/ro-ro berth - 8 Vessels alongside, 4 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Alongside, 2 berthed, 2 waiting, 2 days waiting time. Dry/cement bulk terminal - 3 Vessels alongside, 3 waiting, 5 days waiting time. Liquid bulk - Terminal 3 alongside, 1 waiting, no waiting time. West port - Container/ro-ro berth - 2 Alongside. No waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 3 Alongside, no waiting time. Bulk cement terminal - 2 Alongside, 1 waiting, 2 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 1 Alongside, no waiting time.
MAURITIUS, April 15 - Port Louis - Working normally. 4 Vessels alongside of which 2 discharging and loading containers, 2 discharging general cargo. No idle vessels. 6 Alongside in fishing port.

PAKISTAN, April 14 - Karachi - Three vessels due, up to 24 hours delay expected for container and general cargo vessels, 3 days for fertiliser. 4 Vessels loading rice at berth, 5 containers loading and discharging at berth. 11 Vessels discharging at berth (general cargo, dap, urea, scrap, crude oil, gas oil, chemicals. 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (general cargo, chrome, rice). 3 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (containers, fuel oil). 6 Vessels awaiting orders. Port Qasim - One vessel loading rice at berth, 3 discharging at berth (lpg, rice, iron ore), 1 (jute) waiting at anchorage to discharge.

PHILIPPINES, April 15 - Manila - South harbour - 19 Vessels discharging at berth, 9 discharging at anchorage, 9 waiting outside anchorage to discharge, 2 others waiting. Average waiting time for vessels with a draft less than 8 m. and loa less than 130 m., 1-2 days. Draft more than 9 m. and loa more than 140 m., 3-5 days.

SIERRA LEONE, April 14 - Freetown - Vessels due, 3 aid cargo dischargers, 1 clinker discharger, 3 container dischargers, 1 vehicles discharger, 1 steel discharger. No delays expected, 1 vessel loading scrap metal at berth, none anchored, none bunkering, on orders or under repair. Draft alongside berth 30 ft. 6 in.

SINGAPORE, April 15 - Singapore - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 10 Container vessels berthed. Keppel - 11 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang - 10 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang - 3 General cargo vessels berthed. Jurong port - 5 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminal/sbm buoys - 19 Tankers berthed. Minimum berthing delays at all facilities.

SOUTH KOREA, April 15 - Inchon - 46 Vessels in port (34 berthed, 12 anchored) of which 8 general cargo, 7 logs, 3 each steel, containers, 2 steel billets, 2 corn, 2 cars, 1 each pig iron, coils, soymeal, pulp, fertiliser, wheat, scrap. Anchored, 4 container vessels, 2 each logs, general cargo, 1 each cars, plywood, h-beam, sorghum. Approx. 1 days berthing delay expected. Busan - 158 Vessels in port (45 berthed, 113 anchored including 56 laid up) of which 34 general cargo, 5 containers, one each scrap, coal. 57 Awaiting berth with approx. 2 days delay.

Pohang - 20 in port (19 berthed, 1 anchored)) of which discharging, 3 each scrap, coils, 2 slabs, 1 each iron ore, pipes, structure, billets, steel 6 loading steel, 1 awaiting berth, approx. 1 days delay. Ulsan - 25 In port (23 berthed, 2 anchored) of which discharging, 3 feed meal, 2 fuel oil, 1 each coal, coke, cement, mono ethyl glycol, raw sugar, zinc concentrates, silica sand, chemicals, naphtha, crude oil. Loading, 3 general cargo, 1 each fuel oil, fertiliser, toluene, chemicals, diesel. 2 Awaiting berth. Approx. 1-2 days delay. Masan - Eight berthed of which discharging, 3 scrap, 1 each logs, tapioca, coaches, pig iron 1 loading cars. No delays.

TAIWAN, April 14 - Keelung - Four vessels anchored. Berthing delays, coal 5 days, steel, iron ore 3 days, no delays for grain. Kaohsiung - Six vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 1 day, iron/coal (CSC berth), steel 2 days, coal/scrap (public berth) 3 days. Taichung - Five vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 3-4 days, 1 day for iron ore, coal, scrap, steel, others.

SRI LANKA, April 15 - Colombo - Vessels due, 4 containers, 1 bagged sugar, 1 bulk cement, 1 passenger. No delays expected. 6 Container vessels loading at berth. Discharging at berth, 1 bagged fertiliser, 9 containers, 1 bagged cement, 1 bulk clinker, 1 general cargo, 1 bagged flour, 1 essential services, 1 container vessel waiting at anchorage to load. Waiting at anchorage to discharge, 6 containers, 1 bulk clinker, 2 bagged fertiliser, 2 bagged sugar, 1 vessel bunkering, 1 under repair, 3 in dry-dock, 6 awaiting orders. Galle - One vessel discharging at berth. Trincomalee - One discharging at berth, 2 loading at berth.
